subject.title: fix(auth): remove redundant Cloudflare Access login

question: Should production `switch.openclaw.ai` retire Cloudflare Access and rely exclusively on Better Auth GitHub sessions plus Krillswitch role-scoped tokens for authorization?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes an independent edge identity and automation credential boundary; code review can assess safeguards, but only maintainers can choose the desired permanent defense-in-depth posture and migration policy.

options.title: Approve the application-only boundary
options.body: Accept GitHub-session and Krillswitch-token authorization as the complete production access boundary after reviewing redacted deployment evidence.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare Access
options.body: Retain the existing edge gate and narrow the PR to any non-boundary improvements that do not remove it.

options.title: Stage the transition
options.body: Deploy and observe the application-only path in a controlled environment before deleting the production Access application.

recommendation.title: Approve the application-only boundary
recommendation.body: Accept GitHub-session and Krillswitch-token authorization as the complete production access boundary after reviewing redacted deployment evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed boundary and migration, so they are the clearest person to supply deployment evidence and clarify intended operational ownership.
